summary: Validate OCI index and per-platform image subjects offline
details: Add a separate reader that binds a wrapped OCI index and every requested Linux amd64/arm64 manifest, config and layer to expected digests and source labels, with one cumulative expansion limit.
Add the container-image-check target for offline OCI and container evidence tests while preserving the single-manifest v1 generator and publication path.
Refresh the scoped parser review and offline bindings for its project-authored fixture, preserving external dependency, license, image-scan and maintenance observations and their historical dates.

compatibility.notes: The existing Linux amd64 OCI reader and v1 evidence output remain unchanged; index inspection is a separate internal tooling entry point with an explicit requested platform matrix.

security: Verify every referenced config and blob, per-platform source/version labels, supported baseline platform requirements and cumulative expansion without extracting layers or exposing config environment values.
limitations: Index inspection alone does not qualify arm64 runtime support, multi-platform SBOM generation, signer identity or registry publication.
The new reader intentionally rejects nested indexes, attestation entries and platform requirements outside its restricted publication profile; EVY-1405 remains incomplete.
